subject: ArmPkg/StandaloneMmCpu: pass ARM_MM_HANDLER_CONTEXT to MmHandler
reasons: No tree-wide scale: EDKII_PI_MM_CPU_DRIVER_ENTRYPOINT is a single-implementer protocol (PiMmStandaloneMmCpuDriverEntry is its only implementation), and the (IN UINTN EventId, IN UINTN CommBufferAddr) signature appears at only 3 sites -- the same function as typedef, prototype, and definition -- all changed by this one commit, so the signature-migration rule can never match anything else in the tree.

The other 'plumbing' edits do not generalize soundly: MmiManage(&Guid, NULL, ...) -> MmiManage(&Guid, mMmHandlerContext, ...) keys off a driver-private global and MmiManage(x, NULL, ...) is legitimately NULL throughout edk2, and the CpuDriverEntryPoint((UINTN)ServiceType, ...) -> CpuDriverEntryPoint(&MmHandlerContext, ...) change is a single call site referencing a local.

The bulk of the diff (the gGuidedEventContextV3 global swap, the DelegatedEventLoop FfaMsgInfo/SpmMmInfo restructuring, and the PiMmStandaloneMmCpuDriverEntry body rewrite) is one-off, case-by-case refactoring; this matches the 'large refactor with only a small Coccinelle-friendly subpattern' exclusion in cocci-candidate-criteria.md.
